organizations.publicNote: Local heading for the Pathé imprint printed on the linked 1934 disc. It is kept distinct from the Pathé Frères authority entity, and the label evidence does not identify the company behind this imprint.

sources.shortCitation: BnF, “O chant d’amour de Tahiti !” / “Ho’i-maï”, Pathé PA 1234
sources.fullCitation: Tihoti-re et son ensemble tahitien, with vocal duo by Mlle Maéva and Tihoti; presented by E. Ventrillon. “O chant d’amour de Tahiti !”, from Les révoltés du Bounty, credited to B. Kaper, W. Jurmann and G. Rey, composers / “Ho’i-maï”, credited to G. Rey, composer and lyricist. [Paris]: [Industries Musicales et Electriques Pathé-Marconi], [DL 1940]. One 25 cm 78 rpm disc, Pathé PA 1234, matrices CPT 3351 and CPT 3352. Recording date given as 23 June 1937. Bibliothèque nationale de France, Catalogue général, FRBNF37963787, ARK ark:/12148/cb37963787p.
sources.title: O chant d’amour de Tahiti ! / Ho’i-maï — Pathé PA 1234
sources.creator: Bronisław Kaper, Walter Jurmann, Georges Rey
sources.repository: Bibliothèque nationale de France / Catalogue général
sources.researchNote: The BnF publication statement is [DL 1940]: this denotes legal deposit, not an independently established commercial issue date. The catalogue separately states “Enregistrement : 19370623”; the structured date follows that recording date, 23 June 1937. UNIMARC field 101 gives language code tah, Tahitian. The French title is therefore not evidence that the sung text is French. The catalogue names Rey as co-composer of the Tahiti side, but credits him as composer and lyricist of the coupling “Ho’i-maï”; those roles are not merged. The two matrices are listed together without an explicit title-by-title assignment.

sources.shortCitation: Pathé PA362, “Vivons l’amour, vivons la vie” (Guy Berry, 1934)
sources.fullCitation: Guy Berry. “Vivons l’amour, vivons la vie”, from the Casino de Paris revue Parade de France. Music-hall song by Walter Jurmann, Bronisław Kaper, Henri Varna and Marc Cab. Pathé PA362, matrix cpt-1514-1, 25 cm needle-cut electrical disc, 78 rpm, recorded October 1934. Phonobase record 15273; transfer made 4 February 2023 from the Christian Declerck collection, Dunkirk.
sources.title: Vivons l’amour, vivons la vie — Pathé PA362
sources.creator: Guy Berry
sources.researchNote: Phonobase explicitly gives the recording date as 1934-10-xx; the structured date therefore retains month precision and does not identify the disc’s commercial issue date. The transfer date is separately given as 4 February 2023. The record additionally states that Tino Rossi created the song in 1934, that Mireille, Guy Berry and Priolet also performed it, and that Coda / Heugel published it in Paris in 1934. The Coda publisher credit is supported by that explicit catalogue statement, independently of the Pathé record imprint.

contributions.scopeNote: Issued the recording; the disc carries the imprint “Pathé”.
